### AppBar

The top header of every Safqah app screen: page title, leading back/close control and trailing actions, with 11 legacy layout types (home greeting with wallet balance, inner screens, deal page, onboarding, modal close). It is the screen-level navigation bar, not a content card.

Level: organism · Contains: BackButton, IconButton

Use when:
- Home/dashboard header with greeting, privacy eye and wallet balance (Type=main screens)
- Inner screens and settings pages that need a title, subtitle and back arrow (Type=Inner screens or Small Title)
- Deal page navigation with prev/next and share, including the sticky collapsed state on scroll (Type=Deal page, Deal page-collapsing)
- Full-screen overlays that only need a title and a close X (Type=Close Icon-white / Close Icon-Black)

Don't use when:
- Showing the deal photo, title and developer at the top of a deal page: use HeaderCard (Base card) under the AppBar
- Section navigation between Home/Investments/Wallet/Account: use TabBar
- Titling a region inside the page: use Section
- Desktop web side navigation: use NavigationRail or AppSidebar (shadcn-style)

Accessibility: Render as a header landmark with the title as the page h1; icon-only back, close and share buttons need aria-labels (Back / رجوع); the eye button must announce whether the balance is shown or hidden.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

### Header Info

Home header variant that extends the main-screens AppBar with a returns summary: greeting, masked wallet balance, total returns and expected profit, amount invested and a View payouts list button. It is the 'Main screens with payouts' row of the AppBar reference.

Level: organism · Contains: Button

Use when:
- Investor home screen when the user has active investments and returns to show
- Entry point from home into the payouts / distribution schedule (Show Payouts list on)

Don't use when:
- Inner screens or deal pages: use AppBar with the matching Type
- Building a new portfolio summary from parts: use PortfolioHeader (UserGreeting, WalletChip, ReturnsDisplay)
- A single KPI tile: use Stat

Accessibility: Amounts must be read with currency (324,763 ر.س); the eye toggle announces the hidden state; the payouts button label must describe the destination.

### Header

Product header set (not published to the library) used as the home greeting header and composed inside HeaderCard; State switches between visible and hidden balance and Show Qualified adds the qualified-investor badge. No example image exists, so treat it as a source part rather than a building block.

Level: organism · Part of: Base card

Use when:
- Reproducing the production home header where the balance can be hidden (State=Hide)
- Showing the qualified badge for qualified investors (Show Qualified on)

Don't use when:
- New screens: prefer AppBar (Type=main screens) or PortfolioHeader, which are documented and tokenized
- Home with returns and payouts: use Header Info

Accessibility: When State=Hide the masked value must be announced as hidden, not read as asterisks.

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

| Language | `language` | variant | Arabic, English | Arabic |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

AppBar replaces the legacy Header component set from Global_Design_System (file p2FW9tB2ohmI8ibNgECEyp, node 345:1524). All 11 legacy variant types are now covered, each with LTR and RTL versions. The main screens variants add the production-header refinements drawn from Product_Design Ready-for-Development.

### Token coverage

- Every surface (Wallet card, eye button, modal backdrop, Onboarding shade + headline) - bound to a bg/* token.
- Every text node - fill bound to a text/* token, fontWeight to font/weight/*, fontSize to font/size/*, lineHeight to font/line-height/*.
- Every radius - bound to Radius/* tokens.
- Theme switches (light ↔ dark) and brand updates propagate through every variant without per-instance edits.

### When to use

- On the home/dashboard - main screens (white surface) or main screens-green (light-green surface) variant.
- On any inner screen - Inner screens (with subtitle), Small Title (compact), or Deal page-detail (bold title).
- For modal sheets or full-screen overlays - Close Icon-white (light backdrop) or Close Icon-Black (dark backdrop).
- For multi-step flows - Onboarding (layered shade + headline with drop shadow).
- For deal navigation - Deal page (prev/next), Large Icons (prominent buttons), Deal page-collapsing (sticky-scroll state).

### All 11 variants

11 type variants × LTR/RTL = 22 components. Variant names match the legacy Header type axis verbatim, and the internal layer hierarchy preserves the legacy names (Wallet, Wallet Icon, Wallet Balance, User Name, Headline, shade).

| main screens | 74px |
| --- | --- |
Dashboard/home header on a white surface. Profile star in green circle + greeting title + privacy eye button on the leading side; wallet label + balance card on the trailing side.

| main screens-green | 74px |
| --- | --- |
Same anatomy as main screens but on bg/brand/lightest (light-green surface). Use for branded home variations.

| Inner screens | 92px |
| --- | --- |
Default inner-screen header. Trailing icon group + title column with small chevron, bold title, and description subtitle.

| Deal page-detail | 70px |
| --- | --- |
Trailing icon group + bold title + description + standalone 24px trailing chevron.

| Small Title | 56px |
| --- | --- |
Compact title. Trailing icon group + centered 16px title + 16px leading chevron.

| Onboarding | 114px |
| --- | --- |
Multi-step onboarding header. Layered shade (white 80% opacity, 372×65, rounded-top 16) behind a Headline frame (white, rounded-top 20, drop shadow [0,-3,4,#0000001A], 64px top padding). hasShade toggles the shade layer.

| Deal page | 52px |
| --- | --- |
Trailing label + small icon button on one side; two icon buttons (prev/next, 28×28 with white bg) on the other.

| Large Icons | 64px |
| --- | --- |
Both leading and trailing icons sit in 40px white-bg buttons (rounded-20, 24px icons inside).

| Deal page-collapsing | 48px |
| --- | --- |
Most compact. Flat icons (no backdrops), reduced vertical padding. Use as sticky-scroll collapsed state.

| Close Icon-white | 52px |
| --- | --- |
Modal close header with white-backdrop close X. Title flex-grows alongside.

| Close Icon-Black | 52px |
| --- | --- |
Modal close header with semi-transparent backdrop on the close X (bg/overlay). Close X icon uses icon/inverse.

### Linked tokens

Every raw value across the 22 variants is bound to a Syntropy V2.0 design token. The table below documents each binding category.

### Surface fills

- main screens, Inner screens, Small Title, Deal page-detail, Deal page, Large Icons, Deal page-collapsing, Close Icon-* - bg/base (white).
- main screens-green - bg/brand/lightest (light green).
- Wallet Balance card inside Wallet - bg/base.
- Eye button (Frame 1293) - bg/disabled (off-white pill).
- Close Icon-Black backdrop - bg/overlay (semi-transparent dark scrim).
- Close Icon-white backdrop - bg/base.
- Onboarding Headline - bg/base.
- Onboarding shade - raw rgba(255,255,255,0.8) (semi-transparent white; would benefit from a future bg/surface-translucent token).

### Text colors

- Title - text/default.
- Subtitle / description - text/muted.
- Wallet label "Wallet/المحفظة" - text/brand/primary (brand green for emphasis).
- Balance amount - text/default. Asterisks state ("*****") - same.
- Trailing label "Action/وصف لأمر" - text/muted.
- Modal Close X - icon/inverse (white) on Close Icon-Black; icon/default on Close Icon-white.

### Typography

- fontWeight: font/weight/regular (400), font/weight/medium (500), font/weight/semibold (600), font/weight/bold (700) - bound on every text node.
- fontSize: font/size/12 (small captions, wallet label), font/size/13 (description), font/size/16 (compact titles, modal title), font/size/20 (greeting + main title) - bound on every text node.
- lineHeight: font/line-height/16, font/line-height/20, font/line-height/22, font/line-height/24 - bound matching fontSize.

### Radius

- Radius/4 - wallet label pill, balance card.
- Radius/16 - close button backdrops (modal close X), Onboarding shade top corners.
- Radius/20 - eye button pill, large-icon buttons, Onboarding Headline top corners.

> **Tip:** Theme switches and brand-color updates propagate through every AppBar variant automatically. Switching Semantic to Dark mode flips container backgrounds, text colors, and icon colors with no per-instance edits.

### Component properties

2 variant axes + 13 instance properties. Boolean toggles cover privacy state, profile/eye visibility, leading/trailing toggles, and Onboarding-specific options.

### Variant axes

- Type - 11 options matching legacy Header verbatim.
- Direction - LTR / RTL. Mirrors icon orientation and text alignment.

### Text properties (4)

- Title - main headline. Default "Hello Abrar".
- Subtitle - second line. Default "Wallet balance".
- Balance - amount on main screens. Default "12,000.00".
- TrailingLabel - trailing action label. Default "Action".

### Boolean toggles (9)

- showSubtitle - Inner screens / Deal page-detail subtitle row.
- showLeading - leading icon, chevron, or close button.
- showTrailing - trailing action group.
- showBalance - Wallet section on main screens / main screens-green.
- showProfile - green-circle star profile icon.
- showEyeButton - privacy eye pill button.
- hideBalance - show "*****" placeholder. Designers also manually hide the balance text node OR set Balance="*****".
- hasShade - Onboarding shade layer. Default true.
- hasDivider - placeholder for bottom-divider line. Variants with built-in dividers (Inner screens, Deal page-detail, etc.) already render them.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Final pass 2026-06-11. Replaced AppBar v1 (id 2395:2, deleted) with this 22-variant set. Removed scratch debris (PREVIEW phase2a, Header Hide library reference). Cleaned main screens-green and Onboarding into the AppBar set; both now share the same Type axis as the other 9 legacy types.

> **Tip:** main screens-green uses bg/brand/lightest (#~Color/Primary/LightGreen/200) for a clearly visible green tint. If a softer tint is desired, swap to bg/brand/primary-subtle (LightGreen/50) which is near-imperceptible in light mode.

> **Warning:** Onboarding's shade is raw rgba(255,255,255,0.8) - Syntropy V2.0 doesn't have a semi-transparent white surface token. If you add one (e.g. bg/surface-translucent), update the shade fill to bind to it.

> **Info:** Onboarding's small inline icons are chevron-right (stand-in) because the legacy uses a tiny "logout-3" SVG that isn't in Syntropy Icons. The structural anatomy (shade + headline + drop shadow + extra top padding) matches the legacy exactly.

> **Tip:** Default Title is "Hello Abrar" (English) across all variants - Figma component properties have a single default. Override Title per instance with the appropriate language ("مرحبًا أبرار" for RTL).

> **Warning:** hideBalance only controls the "*****" text node visibility. To fully swap amount → asterisks, designers manually hide the balance text node OR set Balance prop to "*****". A future iteration could automate via paired bindings.
